<h2 class="section-title">India Markets</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">

<h2 class="section-title">Global Cues</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Crude Oil and Currency:</strong> Brent crude prices nearing $90 per barrel have weighed on domestic sentiment and pressured the Indian rupee, forcing the RBI to intervene to defend the currency.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W1</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMinAFBVV95cUxPem5VNVptQWFiVW9YNVZVdTdnUGpLc3RqSC02WUpfeHh0OWU2RHNZQWVBbU5Ra18zYmVhNl9Vam1WLWUyMDlyQktWZV9fNzRyb2YybS0tQUp6YTNueU0zaWwydGFSZHRJZlBIbzVLSFJPc1N5c2RMNk9KaHNILXFmVW81Zkk1dVJWQVFhYTY0eVVlUVpkcmlfNzRXWlA?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W8</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W12</a></span></li>
